edit.description: retire the namespacedJoin describe; point at the judgeable pin instead

summary: Retire tests/paths.test.ts's namespacedJoin describe — all four assertions are identities on POSIX, so the block cannot go red on the suite's platform

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

acceptance: tests/paths.test.ts carries no assertion of the form namespacedJoin(x) === toNamespacedPath(join(x)); the win32 idiom's judgeable pin stays tests/Baton.test.ts's source scan.
notes: Each of the four asserts namespacedJoin(x) === toNamespacedPath(join(x)) — the body verbatim. toNamespacedPath is identity on linux (measured this tick), so all four hold even with the wrapper dropped. tests/Baton.test.ts states exactly this in its own comment and pins the source shape instead. No rule about which wrapping form a site uses exists to pin — spec retired that claim — so the block is retired, not rewritten.
